description:
[AML suspicious activity indicator & national FIU filing engine. Deterministic anomaly analysis, read-only, side-effect free]. Evaluates transaction anomaly indicators (pass-through accounts, volume spikes, structuring) for mandatory STR/SAR reporting under Directive (EU) 2024/1640 Article 50 with tipping-off safeguards.
Usage: Pass transaction pattern indicators to calculate suspicion score and identify the designated national FIU (UIF, TRACFIN, FIU-Germany).
Returns: JSON object with { caseReference: string, suspicionScore: number, suspicionSeverity: string, isStrFilingMandatory: boolean, designatedNationalFiuAgency: object, triggeredRedFlags: array, mandatoryImmediateActions: array }.

anomalyIndicators.description: Red flag anomaly indicators observed during monitoring

inconsistencyWithDeclaredEconomicProfile.description: Disparity between transaction scale and declared financial standing

multipleOffshoreCounterpartiesNoRational.description: Routing involves corporate shells in secrecy jurisdictions

rapidPassThroughWithin48Hours.description: Funds deposited and rapidly wired out without economic rationale

refusesToProvideBeneficialOwnershipData.description: Customer is evasive or refuses beneficial ownership documentation

structuredJustBelowReportingThreshold.description: Transfers deliberately sized just below €10,000 or national thresholds

volumeSpikeOver300PercentHistoric.description: Sudden surge exceeding 300% of customer average activity

caseReference.description: Internal compliance audit case reference or alert ID

customerDeclaredMonthlyIncomeEur.description: Declared baseline monthly income/revenue of the customer in EUR

reportingEntityCountryIso2.description: Country of the reporting obliged entity (e.g. IT, FR, DE, ES, NL)

name: aml_suspicious_activity_screener
